title: Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease End-of-Term Allowances and Settlement Periods by Tier
content:
**Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease — lease-end allowances and settlement periods**

| Tier | Wear forgiveness cap | Loyalty wear forgiveness cap | Loyalty window, days before or after turn-in | Disposition fee waived when the loyalty condition is met |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Lease Tier 5 | $0 | $500 | 90 | No |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 4 | $0 | $500 | 90 | Yes |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 3 | $250 | $750 | 90 | Yes |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 2 | $250 | $750 | 90 | Yes |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 1 | $500 | $1000 | 90 | Yes |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 1+ | $750 | $1500 | 90 | Yes |

**Settlement periods (all six tiers)**

| Period | Calendar days |
|---|---|
| End-of-term payment period: days after the end-of-term invoice by which charges are due | 30 |
| End-of-term charge-off period: days after the turn-in date after which unpaid end-of-term charges are charged off | 120 |
| Security deposit refund period: days after closing within which an unapplied security deposit is refunded | 30 |

**What the figures mean**

- *Wear forgiveness cap*: the excess wear forgiven at lease end without loyalty.
- *Loyalty wear forgiveness cap*: the excess wear forgiven at lease end when the loyalty condition is met.
- *Loyalty window*: the calendar days before or after the turn-in date within which a new Kestrel lease or retail contract qualifies for loyalty treatment.
- *Disposition fee waiver*: whether the tier waives the disposition fee when the loyalty condition is met; Kestrel Lease Tier 5 does not.

**Hypothetical illustration**: a Kestrel Lease Tier 1 lease shows a wear forgiveness cap of $500 and a loyalty wear forgiveness cap of $1000; a Kestrel Lease Tier 4 lease shows $0 and $500.
